profile: local debug, first-party CPU crates optimized at level 2
limitations: Rust core and sampled descendant processes only; excludes WebKit and native UI.
Synthetic local repositories; excludes network, provider credentials and write/recovery workloads.
RSS samples can miss short-lived peaks and do not prove absence of leaks.
Tail latency samples are capped at 2,048 per scenario; observation counts include the full run.
No before/after or cross-product comparison; elapsed run is not a full-workday acceptance test.
Other running applications can influence elapsed latency.
